self_summary: Breadcrumb rules bound to failing tests: each page states the expected behaviour, internals, invariants and failure modes for one proven bug — chat activity readout, bootstrap's default project, dev port picking, SQLite NULL ordering, served HTML encoding, terminal bidi, and worker interpreter resolution.

files.name: agent_activity_readout.md
files.title: Agent activity readout rules
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for the chat activity line: naming the current operation, coarse worker-phase fallback, the 500ms floor, and refinement pass-through invariants.

files.name: bootstrap_default_project.md
files.title: Bootstrap's default_project — which project a machine opens
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for which project a machine opens: browser memory outranks the server, then bootstrap's strict per-caller source order, never cached.

files.name: dev_port_picking.md
files.title: Dev port picking for agent-started servers
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for agent-started dev servers: request a port via flow app free-dev-port, one probe per invocation, and no lease against concurrent pickers.

files.name: null_sort_order.md
files.title: NULL sort order in the SQLite driver
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for SQLite ordering on a field some entities lack: bucket tuples place missing values first, and never coerce them to empty string.

files.name: served_html_encoding.md
files.title: Served app HTML must be read as UTF-8
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for serving a micro-app index.html byte-faithfully as UTF-8 whatever the host codepage, asserting the served text matches disk.

files.name: terminal_bidi.md
files.title: Terminal RTL/bidi rendering contract
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for terminal RTL and bidi: a right-to-left sweep must yield PTY emission order, and why !important and avoiding inline-block are load-bearing.

files.name: worker_interpreter.md
files.title: Worker interpreter resolution
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for worker interpreter resolution: FLOWPAD_PYTHON is handed to the worker as an absolute path and used verbatim from any working directory.
